description: Read-only: for each menu parameter of a node, live-fetch the menu option values (`menuNames` — the machine values you set with `par.val`), their human-readable UI labels (`menuLabels`), and the currently selected value (`current`). Use this before setting a Menu / StrMenu parameter so you pick a valid option instead of guessing. Values come straight from the running TouchDesigner build, so they are authoritative and even include dynamically-populated menus (device lists, file menus) — an empty `menuNames` on a known-menu parameter means the menu has not populated yet (the node has not cooked / the device is not enumerated), not that there is no menu. Requires TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1; when raw exec is unavailable it falls back to the bundled catalog and attaches a stale-catalog warning.

keys.description: Only report these parameter names (case-sensitive). Omit for all menu parameters.

menu_only.description: Only return parameters that actually have a menu (Menu / StrMenu). Set false to see every parameter with its (usually empty) menu.

path.description: Full path of the node whose parameter menus to read.

name: get_parameter_menu
title: Get parameter menu values
